documents.title: Information memorandum
documents.text:
Information memorandum — Esker Holdings (fictional).
In this document "EHH" means Esker Holdings. Esker Holdings reports headcount of 877 for FY2024. Esker Holdings reports enterprise value of USD 1544.7 million for FY2025 on a reported basis. Esker Holdings reports normalised net working capital of $15.3m for LTM to 30 Jun 2025 on a reported basis. Esker AB reports EBITDA of $67.8m for FY2025 on a reported basis. For Esker Holdings, the material adverse change clause is read as: excludes general market downturns. For Esker Holdings, the form of consideration is: part-share consideration with a 12-month lock-up. The fiscal year of Esker Holdings ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Financial due diligence report
documents.text:
Financial due diligence report — Esker Holdings (fictional).
Esker Holdings reports fte of 994 for FY2024. Esker Holdings reports enterprise value of $1399.3m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Esker Holdings reports gross margin of 56.8% for FY2025. Esker Holdings reports annual customer churn of 12.3% for FY2025. For Esker Holdings, the material adverse change clause is read as: covers any event reducing EBITDA by more than 10%. For Esker Holdings, the form of consideration is: all-cash consideration.
